text: Manifest sequencing decision (lead, 2026-09-26). UI-C added report-spec/report roles and the ReportOf relation additively within eyes4s.manifest@1, and manifest@1 documents without them decode unchanged (verified by the UI-C review). New roles and relations are therefore additive within @1, with no single manifest@2 bump. Each branch (SourceRef SourceFile/ImportSpec/LedgerSource, UI-E ResultPayload, CR4 S2 analysis roles) adds its own roles after merging main and lands in merge order. A @2 bump is reserved for a change to the manifest's existing shape. Conditions for an additive change: existing @1 fixtures decode byte-identically, and an unknown role is refused as a typed error, never ignored.
